cards.card_text: Instead, David tells God, “…my ears You have opened.” Then David says, “Here I am, I have come…” and he says it is written about him in the scroll.
cards.verse_text: Sacrifice and offering You did not desire, but my ears You have opened. Burnt offerings and sin offerings You did not require. Then I said, “Here I am, I have come—it is written about me in the scroll:
